source: Synthetic prototype fixtures authored during implementation; not institutional repair history.

samples.description: The desktop beeps repeatedly and does not detect its RAM module.
The hard drive makes clicking noises and is no longer detected in BIOS.
The computer overheats and shuts down even though the room has normal power.
The motherboard cannot detect the installed memory after a hardware upgrade.
Windows shows a blue screen every time the operating system starts.
The spreadsheet application crashes immediately after opening a document.
Windows is stuck in an automatic repair loop after an update.
The installed operating system freezes when users log in.
The Ethernet cable is connected but DHCP does not assign an IP address.
Computers in the lab cannot reach the network gateway.
The computer reports an IP address conflict and cannot access the campus network.
The network adapter connects to Wi-Fi but cannot obtain a valid IP address.
Several keys on the external keyboard no longer respond.
The USB mouse cursor jumps erratically when the mouse is moved.
The laboratory printer repeatedly jams paper while printing.
The external webcam is not detected when connected to a working USB port.
The UPS turns off immediately when mains electricity is interrupted.
The lab circuit breaker trips when the equipment is switched on.
The wall power outlet does not supply electricity to any device.
Sparks and a burning smell are coming from the power strip.
It is broken.
The computer is not working properly.
Please help me with this device.

repairs.issue: The computer beeps and the RAM is not detected.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: reseated a faulty RAM module; memory diagnostic passed.

repairs.issue: Hard disk clicking and missing from BIOS.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: replaced a failing drive and verified detection.

repairs.issue: Windows stuck in a boot repair loop after updating.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: rolled back the failed update and verified boot.

repairs.issue: Spreadsheet application crashes when opening documents.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: repaired the application installation and tested documents.

repairs.issue: Ethernet is connected but DHCP does not issue an IP address.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: corrected the DHCP network configuration and verified connectivity.

repairs.issue: Computer cannot access network because of duplicate IP address.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: corrected duplicate addressing and verified gateway access.

repairs.issue: External keyboard keys do not respond.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: replaced the faulty keyboard and tested all keys.

repairs.issue: Printer paper is repeatedly jammed in the feed path.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: cleared the feed path under technician supervision and verified printing.

repairs.issue: UPS battery fails immediately during a mains power interruption.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: technician replaced the failed UPS battery and tested backup.

repairs.issue: The wall outlet does not power any equipment.
repairs.resolution: Synthetic fixture: authorized electrical staff repaired the outlet and verified supply.
